selection: minimum pooled log loss on up to three most recent completed development seasons; latest season excluded
audit: last season, already viewed in older versions; exploratory rather than pristine holdout
injuries: only if timestamped pre-match historical availability is supplied; no retrospective season totals
season_identity: Use source filename or explicit Season, including July 2020 in 2019/20
quality_policy: Retain outcome and quarantine both affected-side shot values when target shots exceed total; explicit flag and provenance
